profile.headline: Principle Software Engineer at Trimark Associates
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Databases, Windows Communication Foundation (WCF), .NET Framework, C#, and Visual Studio. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science focused in Software Engineering from Colorado Technical University.

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead developer team responsible for rewrite of flagship product.
• Contribute to code reviews, ensuring a high-quality product.
• Mentor the development team in SOLID principles.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · C# · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Agile Methodologies · Powershell · Azure Functions · FastEndpoints · Unit Testing · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Agile Application Development · Scrum · Postman API · Azure Load Testing · JMeter

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
• Led the flagship core development team, which served as the primary revenue generator for the company, driving key projects and innovations to support business growth.
• Led the enhancement of the company's ticketing system, driving growth from 255,361 tickets and 146,800 average payments per day in 2020 to 802,238 tickets and 414,827 payments per day in 2024.
• Led the PARCS and Valet development teams, comprising 13 engineers, enhancing the consistency of software releases.
• Designed a three-master data synchronization model utilizing AWS FIFO queues to efficiently incorporate intention-revealing changes.
• Engineered and developed software from the ground up, utilizing Azure Alerts, Kusto queries, and Azure Functions to proactively detect customer issues and notify the support team, enabling them to take preventative measures.
• Developed and utilized multiple JMeter scripts for thorough load testing of various Web APIs using Azure Load Testing.
• Designed and implemented a comprehensive metrics system to assess business needs and established a weekly reporting process, publishing the results to Confluence for enhanced visibility and decision-making.
• Mentored and developed engineering talent.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected, developed and implemented a .NET 8 WebAPI-driven solution for our monthly import process, leveraging Web Jobs, Queues, Application Insights, SignalR, and Azure Storage, resulting in annual savings of approximately $80,000 for the company.
• Developed Azure DevOps pipelines for building, testing, and deploying applications to an isolated staging environment, ensuring robust and reliable release processes.

positions.title: Development Manager
positions.description:
• Oversaw the SCRUM process for both internal and external development teams using JIRA and Rally.
• Contributed to code reviews, ensuring high code quality, consistency, and adherence to SOLID principles and best practices.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented the MongoDB NoSQL database in the TOPAZ Elements enterprise product, optimizing data retrieval by streamlining views for faster access and improved performance.
• Spearheaded the migration from GetEventStore, substantially lowering storage and maintenance costs for customers and reducing data errors.
• Implemented CQRS using Microsoft Message Queue (MSMQ), enabling a clear separation of state and read models to enhance system scalability and maintainability.
• Developed multiple data utilities that enabled customers to seamlessly transition between software versions, ensuring data integrity and eliminating the risk of data loss.
• Led the development of the software to successfully replace the Silverlight component of the Protocols module with Angular.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Senior Team member for developing the TiPSView alarm management system.  Created several of the major backend components of the TiPSView software package.  Technologies used were C#, ASP.NET, MVC, Ajax, ExtJs, .NET framework and the .NET reflection model.
• Spearheaded the migration of the software package from .NET 1.1 code to 3.5.
• Created several data wedge software solutions allowing the LogMate Capture program to integrate with Cygnet, Sybase, mySQL, and Multiple ASCII files.  Technologies used were C#, .NET framework and the .NET reflection model.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
• Senior Team member for developing the PremiSys access control system.  Created several of the 
major backend components of the PremiSys software package including several virtual services to 
handle the various aspects of talking to the Mercury hardware panels.  Created several of the UI 
elements including Photo Recall and the Transaction and Alarm Acknowledgement windows.  
Technologies used were C#, ASP.NET, WCF, WPF, .NET framework and the .NET Interop model.
• Team member for developing the Expressions ID identification badging software.  Created UI base 
code to allow the stripping of the background from a photo allowing the head to “float” overtop of 
a background on the card.  A method that is still in use today.
Technologies used were C# and the .NET framework.
• Team member for developing a new version of the IDentiPASS and IDentiPASS Plus access 
systems.  They provide sophisticated monitoring of the Series 9000 access control hardware.  
Developed several GUI utilities aimed at allowing the customer to configure and test the hardware 
in their own environment.  Created a conversion utility that allowed the database to be either 
Microsoft Access or Microsoft SQL Server.
• Team member for developing a new version of the IVIS Plus badging software.  Developed the UI 
for the additional photo software module as well as a utility to transfer the screen and card 
designs along with the database to technical support when needed.  
Technologies used were VB6, COM, ActiveX and C++.
• Lead and sole developer for the Centurion stand-alone access control system that supports up to 
four Centurion panels per site.  The software was both Windows and Pocket PC based to allow for 
greater flexibility in the field.  
Technologies used were VB6, COM, ActiveX and C++.
• Assisted in the development of; and implemented development processes such as Scrum and 
Waterfall, and Modified Waterfall software engineering models.
